authority_statement: Authoritative only for the synthetic warehouse replenishment demonstration.
notice: All inventory, supplier, SKU and order data is synthetic. It describes no real organization or system of record.

passages.passage: A governed replenishment proposal may be created only for an approved SKU and supplier combination. The inventory manager must approve the exact SKU, location, supplier, and quantity before a replenishment order reaches Dynamics 365. Blocked or discontinued SKUs must be rejected regardless of a model recommendation.

passages.source_title: Synthetic SKU and Supplier Eligibility Record
passages.passage: SKU-BEARING-042 at warehouse SEA-01 is approved for replenishment from supplier SUP-1007 in a fixture quantity of 120 units. SKU-BEARING-041 is discontinued and unsafe to reorder. These values are synthetic demonstration fixtures, not live inventory facts.
